description: Create a campaign with a goal (what to advertise or attain). A campaign is public and free by default; setting visibility "private" costs 1 credit. Contract (deliverable, compensationCents, and platforms, the platforms one payment covers), creator posting date, campaign details declassifying date (embargoUntil), disclosure, and marketInformation are accepted. Optional creators, each a profileId and fitScore pick, adds them as manual matches in the same call, as add_campaign_matches does, and the result carries matches with the added and present counts; any other key on a creator fails the call with a validation error; a creator id outside the catalog fails the call before anything is created or charged. Needs a credential.

contract.description: Compensation in USD cents, the paid deliverable, the platforms the creator posts on, and optional creator posting date.

creatorPostingDate.description: Creator posting date as the start of a UTC calendar day, an RFC 3339 date-time at midnight UTC such as 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z. Any other instant is refused. Omit when unset.

platforms.description: Platforms the creator posts on for the one payment: ig for Instagram, tt for TikTok. A creator posts on each one they run.

creators.description: Creators to add to the new campaign: the profileId and fitScore of each, the id and fitScore of a search_creators creator or the profileId and fitScore of a get_list creator

fitScore.description: Fit score from search_creators, 0 to 1, or null when unknown

disclosure.description: Paid partnership disclosure. Required before send.

embargoUntil.description: Campaign details declassifying date as the start of a UTC calendar day, an RFC 3339 date-time at midnight UTC such as 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z. Any other instant is refused. It needs a contract in the same request. Omit when unset.

allOf.description: Campaign goal: audience, brand vibe, or objective. Used as the generate search brief.

idempotencyKey.description: Client-generated key. A valid repeat with the same key answers with the campaign the first call created, even when its other fields differ.

marketInformation.description: When the campaign's name and pay per creator may join the going rate, the list of campaigns and the typical pay other organizations and creators see, which sets the platform fee: releaseDelayMonths 0 to 18 holds them back that many months after the first funding request since the campaign last held no funds for a fee of that many percent of the creator pool, and a releaseDelayMonths of null keeps them out for a 20 percent fee. A campaign joins no earlier than its declassifying date.

visibility.description: Defaults to public. Private costs 1 credit.
